prompt: Inside any cloned repository whose git remote URL ends with the standard ".git" suffix (the default for clones, e.g. https://github.com/monalisa/octo-cat.git), gh commands that resolve the current repository from the remote now misidentify it: the CLI resolves the repo as "monalisa/octo-cat.git" and API requests fail with 404. The same commands work fine if the remote URL has no ".git" suffix. Find and fix the regression.
